body: From the DM-171 review (orchestrator): `src/core/services/plannedBaselines.ts` `changedDraftTickets`/`ticketView` compare the draft with the viewed bundle, which is the run's pinned revision. When a run is pinned to an older revision and any draft is open, an already-saved re-budget shows as `draftBudget`. Compare against the epic's current saved revision (or the draft's base revision) when you build the baseline inputs.
